items.title: 5.9.1 Factors affecting the boiling points of liquids (boiling point par asar karne wale factors) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.9.1, printed pages 107-108, with Quick Check 5.7 and answers.

blocks.text: Liquid ka boiling point in factors se badalta hai:
1) Strength of intermolecular forces (forces ki taqat)

Intermolecular forces jitni mazboot, vapour pressure utna kam aur boiling point utna zyada. H₂O ka zyada boiling point batata hai ke us ki intermolecular forces ethanol aur methanol se mazboot hain (Table 5.4).

blocks.caption: Table 5.4 760 torr (1 atm) par kuch aam liquids ke boiling points

blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure bahar ke pressure ke barabar ho jaye. Is ka matlab: bahar ka pressure badlega to boiling point bhi badlega. Bahar ka pressure zyada ho to liquid ko apna vapour pressure us ke barabar lane ke liye zyada heat chahiye, yani boiling point barh jata hai. Isi tarah kam pressure par liquid kam heat le kar kam temperature par ubal jata hai.

Maslan pani 1489 torr par 120 °C par ubalta hai aur 23.7 torr par sirf 25 °C par. Murree ki paharion par bahar ka pressure 700 torr hai, wahan pani 98 °C par ubalta hai, jabke Mount Everest ki choti par 323 torr par pani sirf 69 °C par ubal jata hai.

Pressure cooker se hum ubalte pani ke surface par pressure khud barha sakte hain. Pressure cooker ek closed container (band bartan) hai; is mein banne wala vapour bahar nahi nikal pata, is liye pani ke surface par pressure barh jata hai aur boiling temperature barh jata hai. Pani zyada heat absorb (jazb) karta hai, is liye khana zyada pressure par jaldi pak jata hai.

blocks.caption: Pani ka boiling point aur bahar ka pressure

blocks.prompt: a) Oonche paharon (high altitude) par khana pakana mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Oonchai par hawa ka pressure kam hai, is liye pani 100 °C se kam temperature par ubal jata hai (Murree mein 98 °C). Kam garam pani mein khana der se pakta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Pressure cooker mein khana jaldi kyun pakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pressure cooker vapour ko nikalne nahi deta, is liye andar pressure barhta hai aur pani 100 °C se zyada temperature par ubalta hai. Zyada garam pani khana jaldi pakata hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Dono mein hydrogen bonds hain, phir bhi pani (100 ℃) ka boiling point ethanol (78 ℃) se zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Pani ka har molecule on average do hydrogen bonds banata hai (do H aur do lone pairs), jabke ethanol ka sirf ek O−H hai. Pani mein forces zyada mazboot hain, vapour pressure kam hai, is liye boiling point zyada hai.

items: Mazboot intermolecular forces: kam vapour pressure, zyada boiling point (pani 100 > ethanol 78.3 °C).

Zyada bahar ka pressure boiling point barhata hai, kam pressure ghatata hai: 1489 torr par 120 °C, Murree (700 torr) 98 °C, Everest (323 torr) 69 °C; pressure cooker isi principle (asool) par chalta hai.
